title: Voynich Computational Analysis Toolkit - Data
description: Data processing infrastructure for computational analysis of the Voynich Manuscript: parsers, validators and builders for the scholarly transliterations of voynich.nu, and the datasets they build (published on Hugging Face as Ched-ai/voynich-eva, Ched-ai/voynich-manuscript-metadata, Ched-ai/voynich-transcription-mismatch and Ched-ai/voynich-transliterations, CC-BY-4.0). The code is MIT.
